authority.source_authority: DAD governs this package; enrolled repositories retain authority over local CI adoption.

non_overlap_statement: Only primary-writer edits tracked files; scouts and checker are read-only.

roles.why_needed: A cheap inventory prevents duplicate lessons, skills, validators, and templates.
roles.mission: Find reusable overlaps and exact gaps in DAD CI and dependency surfaces.
inputs: DAD registries, lessons, workflows, assets, graphs, tests, and instructions
roles.authority: Read-only DAD inventory; no downstream content or edits.
acceptance_conditions: Exact paths and IDs support a dedupe conclusion.
stop_conditions: Search would require downstream content or mutation.

roles.why_needed: Shared CI contracts require proportional medium-effort synthesis.
roles.mission: Propose provider-neutral semantics, evaluator behavior, integration surfaces, and portability evidence.
roles.authority: Read-only advice; cannot edit or approve its own proposal.
acceptance_conditions: Design covers requested lanes, edges, fixtures, exceptions, and deadlocks.
stop_conditions: Reviewed authority sources cannot resolve a conflict.

readiness_conditions: Existing surfaces and alternatives are compared.

roles.why_needed: A metadata-only inventory bounds migration without downstream reads or writes.
roles.mission: Identify enrolled-repo metadata, audit limits, and human-reviewed adoption routes.
roles.authority: Read-only DAD metadata; no downstream traversal or mutation.
acceptance_conditions: Findings state audit depth, evidence status, and non-mutation boundary.
stop_conditions: A conclusion would require downstream workflow contents.

roles.why_needed: One writer keeps schema, evaluator, fixtures, registries, navigation, skill, and scaffolds coherent.
roles.mission: Implement the provider-neutral capability and deterministic evidence.
roles.authority: May edit only the isolated DAD worktree; no downstream or global changes.

readiness_conditions: Writer checks pass and diff is stable.

roles.why_needed: High-risk CI governance requires independent false-positive and false-negative review.
roles.mission: Red-team the completed capability against requested edge cases and authority boundaries.
roles.authority: Read-only review; cannot edit or approve authored work.
acceptance_conditions: Findings cover requested risk classes and state proceed, repair, or escalate.
stop_conditions: Evidence is incomplete or independence is compromised.

readiness_conditions: Raw permitted artifacts and results are available.

proof_obligations.description: Prove suites follow ownership and dependency edges without unrelated blockers or silent broadening.
Prove provider neutrality and metadata-only human-gated adoption.
